audit.whatIsWrong: tldr and report[0].t both make an unsupported-magnitude claim ('doubles what his toolbox singles') without grounding what is being doubled. breakdown.cooldowns names The Big One as matchup-defining but has no cooldown number. dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles. audit.why: Seraphine's Passive genuinely double-casts every third spell per the kit, so the fix is to ground the claim in that mechanic rather than drop it. Corki's R (Missile Barrage) fires every 2s with every third shot banking as a Big One — that's the real number missing from breakdown.cooldowns.
